annotations.title: Solana balance: SOL balance of a wallet

description: SOL balance of a Solana wallet, read live from mainnet in lamports and SOL, plus its SPL token accounts (mint, symbol for well-known tokens, decimals, amount) when the public node serves them; otherwise tokens is null with a note. Use to check a Solana wallet before a payment. An address that is not 32-byte base58 is 400, uncharged. Example: address=vines1vzrYbzLMRdu58ou5XTby4qAqVRLmqo36NKPTg. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
